name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey in motorsport began in his youth, captivated by the engineering marvels of Formula 1. He pursued mechanical engineering with unwavering dedication, eventually landing a role with a Chinese touring car team. His meticulous approach and problem-solving skills quickly propelled him through the ranks.

Wei joined Arrow McLaren as a technical director, drawn to their ambition and innovative spirit. He is known for his data-driven decision-making and ability to bridge the gap between engineering theory and practical on-track performance. Wei's unique approach emphasizes collaboration and continuous improvement, fostering a culture of learning and innovation within the team. He is respected for his calm demeanor under pressure and his commitment to developing the next generation of motorsport engineers.

His experience in a variety of racing series gives him a unique perspective when approaching issues with the car. Wei is a true perfectionist, always striving for that extra tenth of a second that can make all the difference. His experience makes him an invaluable part of the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Wei is a man of medium build with a focused gaze and a distinguished air.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Insists on starting every meeting with a traditional Chinese tea ceremony.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
